how_its_made:
Here's Google docs to explain what we did and why. 

*https://docs.google.com/document/d/1llJF5WfYsm_x3cfN5O7oQjy22LtKIWzaiRrmmC5yeP0/edit?usp=sharing



















Dear, NFTHack & Sponsors.



We’re NFTBase.



NFTbase is the metaverse marketplace and community where you can buy, sell and create NFT items. We’ll make the world where human creativity is fully respected.



NFTBase itself is what we've been building as a side project since last January, however, to participate in NFTHack, we decided to develop something creative on top of what we’ve been building and we tried to experiment that we’ve never done before :)  



Here’s what we did for the NFTHack event. The keyword can be like below.

Upload website on IPFS 

Integration on ENS

NFT 3D showcase

NFT Marketplace (Coming soon)







[Uploading NFTBase website on IPFS : Website without third party cloud computing]



1) We uploaded our website on IPFS by using Pinata service, and we got IPFS hash.

https://gateway.pinata.cloud/ipfs/QmPMVVma6XazVjjfg8Ra1sVqhCW4tHJMLJ2h4njpYiFz5R/

* This hash was pinned on 20th March







3) To activate our website on IPFS without AWS, we revised the way we pull resources to present website contents. (If you don't do this task, your website can not work well on IPFS, because IPFS hash makes website resource path messed up)



***We believe that our attempt to use IPFS for our website can be a good example and shows how people can use IPFS for their service.







[Website Domain integration to ENS]

1) We've connected the IPFS hash by using ENS service - "nftbase.eth"

https://etherscan.io/tx/0x7123c06cc908a4df769ca561c776d73f0a903e3a91f654adabc23afe94d72c97

You can check the time through the transaction.





2) We put an IPFS hash into our ENS domain, so now we can access NFTBase by typing "nftbase.eth.link" on your browser. (We believe that in the future, dapp services on Ethereum can use "eth.link" domains to present their identity as Dapp. 

https://nftbase.eth.link



***We believe that our hack can be a good use case of ENS domain ! 







[3D Showcase]

The reason we developed 3D Showcase for NFTHack is that 

1) There are tons of NFT items on marketplaces, but the marketplaces can not display all the NFT items on their market.

2) There is not an equal opportunity for artists. It means some artists have luck to display their NFT items on the top of the frontend, but majority even can not show their NFT items to NFT collectors.

3) We have to give artists more chances to display their NFT items.

4) We believe that by using 3D places such as 3D showcases, we can display more NFT items efficiently.

5) We will develop not only 3D but also VR showcases where users can join, then they will wander the showcase and enjoy appreciating a number of NFT items simultaneously.



You can see our example 3D showcase here:

* http://nftbase.ai/three





[NFT Marketplace]

Today (20th March) we did some updates for this NFTHack. We updated our website to have a better UI. We did not integrate our Ethereum smart contract for NFT exchange, but we will make it possible for users to buy NFT on 3D showcases as well.



[Before Update]





[Updated UI on 20th March, 2021]





[Summary]

We enjoyed participating in NFTHack. Thanks a lot for your effort and kind guidance, NFTHack and Sponsors ! 

It was a great chance for us to think about our current position, and how to make a better NFT culture and how we can contribute ourselves after we launch NFTBase. It was a pleasure to participate in NFTHack.



Due to NFTHack, our team could gather together offline, and had a lot of discussion about how we can show something interesting and cool to people. This was the first time our team members met offline, and it became a huge inspiration and motivation for our project. (Because we proceed with NFTBase as a side project). 



If we can have a good chance like NFTHack in the future, we will make a huge progress with this project and be part of the big stream of NFT in the world.
